items.title: SpaceX stock below $100 is a buying opportunity: Panel on end of lockup period
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) stock continues to near $100 per share on Thursday as the space venture's lockup period expires, allowing employees and early investors to sell their stock. Slatestone Wealth chief market strategist Kenny Polcari and AllSource Investment Management founder Patrick Kennedy share their outlook on SpaceX stock value, especially as over 900 million shares get unlocked.
